# lib/fsm module

Vendor-agnostic table-driven finite state machine engine. This page is the reference for the `lib/fsm` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family. Build it with the repository build driver, or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

| Family | Example | Source |
|---|---|---|

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/fsm` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/fsm). This page does not restate it. This is a documentation gap: the manifest carries no function list to generate a table from.

## Limits

- Not built for 16F870, 16F871, 16F872. Reason: RAM: HAL _g_ccp_callbacks do not fit (XC8 error 1250).
- Not built for 18F2455, 18F2550. Reason: example needs lib/tick, which does not fit on this part (RAM).
